pawCare.title: Paw Care
pawCare.description: A web-based application designed to help veterinarians calculate customized nutrition formulas for pets based on medical conditions, weight and dietary requirements.

orvia.title: Orvia (Operating Room Management System)
orvia.description: A program designed to help users solve arithmetic problems automatically with step-by-step solutions.

optSense.title: optSense (HVAC Monitoring System)
optSense.description: A real-time HVAC and operating room equipment monitoring platform designed to ensure environmental control standards in surgical rooms, The system streams live data to a central company dashboard, enabling immediate issue detection and response across multiple hospital.

eSign.title: E-sign (Operating Room Management System)
eSign.description: A Smart Operating Room (OR) management application designed to streamline surgical scheduling and resource allocation. By utilizing a user interface inspired by the intuitive flow of Google Calendar, E-Sign bridges the gap between digital planning and physical workspace awareness. The system integrates seamlessly with e-Paper displays at the OR entrance to provide real-time, high-visibility updates, ensuring that medical staff can manage room occupancy and coordinate patient care with surgical precision.

univa.title: Univa (Ultrasound Utilization Management System)
univa.description: A centralized ultrasound utilization management platform designed to monitor machine usage across departments and rooms, track maintenance history, and support data-driven decisions on equipment capacity and investment planning.

zentrix.title: Zentrix.ai
zentrix.description: Zentrix.ai is an intelligent Agentic Chat Interface designed to bridge the gap between complex databases and actionable business insights. By leveraging an AI Agent architecture, the platform enables users to query connected databases using natural language. Zentrix.ai doesn't just 'talk—it' 'acts' by autonomously selecting and executing the right tools to perform data analysis, summarize sales trends, identify top-performing products, or track outstanding payments, all within a conversational context.

delph.title: Delph.ai
delph.description: Delph.ai is an advanced AI-driven chat interface designed to transform how users interact with complex documents. Built on a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture, the application allows users to upload PDF files and engage in a dynamic conversation with the content. Delph.ai leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to parse dense information, providing instant, contextually accurate answers while grounding its responses directly in the uploaded source material.

sumi.title: Sumi.ai
sumi.description: Sumi.ai is an intelligent AI Recruitment & Candidate Prescreening Platform designed to revolutionize the hiring process. By integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework, the system automates the tedious task of manual resume screening. Sumi.ai allows HR professionals to define specific job requirements and leverages AI to critically analyze, score, and rank candidates based on their experience, skills, and qualifications, significantly reducing time-to-hire while improving placement quality.

goldBread.title: Gold Bread
goldBread.description: Goldbread is a comprehensive Back-office Management Ecosystem designed to streamline sales, logistics, inventory and financial operations through integrated Mobile and Web applications. With a centralized dashboard for management, digitizes the entire sales-to-delivery lifecycle. It eliminates manual errors in supply chain, providing a 'single source of truth' for businesses with high-volume distribution needs.
